name: FuriosaAI Hot Chips 2024 blog: RNGD GPT-J about 12 queries per second
notes: Vendor blog dated 2024-08-26. Prose: a single RNGD is generating about 12 queries per second on GPT-J 6B, expected to rise as the software stack is refined. The comparison table (GPT-J 6B MLPerf at 99 percent accuracy, queries per second and power versus L40S, Gaudi 2, TPU v5e) is an image and is captioned as unverified by MLPerf, so those comparison numbers were not transcribed. TDP on this page is 180 W.
